title: Amazon API Gateway to Amazon CloudWatch Logs
description: Create a REST API that proxies requests directly to Amazon CloudWatch Logs to put and get log events, without a Lambda function.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint that connects directly to Amazon CloudWatch Logs using an AWS service integration. No Lambda function is required.

The API exposes two POST methods. 'POST /putLog' maps to the CloudWatch Logs PutLogEvents action to put a log event into a log stream, and 'POST /getLog' maps to the GetLogEvents action to read log events back from the stream.

API Gateway assumes an AWS IAM role that allows GetLogEvents and PutLogEvents on a single log stream. Mapping templates fix the log group and log stream, escape the message, and transform the JSON body (ts and message) into the request format expected by the CloudWatch Logs API.
This is useful for browser or mobile clients, IoT devices, or third-party systems that need to write to or read from CloudWatch Logs over plain HTTPS without bundling the AWS SDK or signing requests.
Review the Amazon API Gateway and Amazon CloudWatch Logs quotas for the limits that apply when working with this pattern.
